migration.behavior: Retain additive tables/indexes; never DROP or rewrite customer/payment data

steps.operation: Set PHIOS_P9_CHECKOUT_ENABLED=false and PHIOS_P9_CANARY_ENABLED=false; preserves read/refund scope via durable private policy
Set REPORT_PROVIDER_LIVE_ALLOWED=false; no new spend. Reconcile all reserved/unknown outcomes before source replacement.
Set PHIOS_P9_WATCHDOG_SAFE_MODE=true; stop new claims after identifying in-flight jobs. Keep conditional refunds processing through governed owner/verified webhook.
Preserve G3/G5 private receipts and private policy so authenticated historical reads and conditional refunds survive canary admission expiry/closure.
Disable PHIOS_P9_RENDERER_ENABLED after in-flight render reconciliation; restore only verified previous renderer revision if applicable.
Restore exact previous deployed Pages SHA only after it is identified and compatible with retained migration 18. No restoring arbitrary local HEAD or QA renderer to production.

refundOwner: Retain signed webhook and idempotent conditional G5 transport; no discretionary successful-order refund
forbidden: erase paid jobs or financial receipts
